title: Fix channel image popup layout and add screenshot coverage
summary: Owner asked to fix the poorly positioned image popup and add it to the screenshot suite. The image viewer was progressively centered, changed to a full-screen overlay with a naturally sized/capped image and close behavior, and refined with a smaller translucent close control and spacing. The image-viewer screenshot screen was added. These commits are ancestors of current HEAD, so the work is integrated; the thread reports a fast-forward push that included the commits. Final visual/typecheck evidence is incomplete.
nextAction: Buddies UI Engineer: run the image-viewer screenshot against the final UI (including the close-button and border changes) on desktop and phone, and confirm pnpm typecheck; attach the resulting evidence to the originating thread or a newly linked task if tracking is needed.
evidence: Thread replies post_01a0f3e0-dfae-754e-9e17-b84d84c40eeb, post_01a0f640-ae2b-727c-be50-45d76437c9ef, and post_01a0f650-57b3-70fc-adaa-e17101db38ea report implementation details and desktop/phone screenshots; the final reply explicitly says its screenshot predates the border fix and typecheck was not run.
Commits e36447d, 7e9d75b, and b6455ea are ancestors of HEAD; HEAD includes ChannelContent.css, ChannelMarkdown.tsx, and tools/screenshots.mjs changes.
Current HEAD tools/screenshots.mjs has the image-viewer screen and checks for an open channel-image-overlay dialog.
The supplied tasks-snapshot.json contains no matching image-viewer/channel-image task.
limitations: No tests or screenshot run were performed for this review, per instruction.

A reply reports the commits were included in a fast-forward push from 09d8b0e to 8290148; the required commits are integrated in current HEAD, but this review did not independently inspect remote state.
The working tree is dirty with unrelated work, so conclusions are based on committed HEAD evidence only.
